# Replay fixtures

Copied unchanged from the upstream analyzer repository, master commit
`8b2b97d7a753ae7422adaf19b010e91c3ed54327`:

- `big.hbr2`: `sample recordings/HBReplay-2020-04-02-23h11m.hbr2`
- `handball.hbr2`: `sample recordings/2020-05-07.hbr2`

[Original recordings](https://github.com/haxball-replay-analyzer/haxball-replay-analyzer.github.io/tree/8b2b97d7a753ae7422adaf19b010e91c3ed54327/sample%20recordings)
